name: The Caiden Cube 3x3
description: The Caiden Cube is the signature cube of competitive speedcuber and Cubing.gg coach Caiden Lee. This puzzle is a MoYu RS3 M V5 3x3 (Ball Core UV + Robot Cube Stand) that comes lubed with a balanced mixture of Angstrom Gravitas, Angstrom Dignitas and DNM-37. With this light Angstrom setup and slightly loose tensions, this puzzle is set up to be an exact replica of Caiden's main speedcube.
